name: PopulationOriginsOrAncestryResearchOnly
summary: The card component of Population Origins or Ancestry Research Only (DUO_0000011). The requester's project intends to use the data for a population origins or ancestry purpose the owner allows, and the requester accepted the terms. Decides about the requester.

allowedPurposes.description: Purpose terms, as they appear in IntendedDataUseCredential.useOnlyFor.purposes, that make an IDU usable: at least one of its purposes must be in this list. If the key is missing, no IDU qualifies and access is denied.
